love.summary: Most readers sense emotional healing and transition in love this week — letting go of past wounds, manipulation, or heartbreak is essential to opening yourself up to something more genuine and fulfilling.
love.disagreement: Some readers saw an exciting new connection arriving, while others pointed to ongoing struggles like communication gaps or dishonesty still needing resolution before love can truly flourish.

finance.summary: Most readers sense a financial turning point this week — new opportunities may be arriving to reward past efforts, but staying persistent and investing your energy only in what truly gives back will be key.
finance.disagreement: Some readers focused on incoming opportunities and rewards, while others emphasized reassessing current paths and confronting difficult truths before progress can be made.

career.summary: Career momentum is building for Pisces this week — most readers agree that persistence through challenges is essential right now, as breakthroughs, new opportunities, and tangible rewards appear to be just within reach.
career.disagreement: Some readers focused on an imminent external opportunity to seize boldly, while others emphasized enduring an ongoing difficult stretch before the payoff arrives.

family.summary: Few readers touched on family this week; the one who did pointed to possible feelings of betrayal or injustice in a domestic or parental situation, with potential legal dimensions.

overall_tone_summary: A door you kept closed swings open, and walking through it feels right.
